blocks.text: What are we gonna play? Join the Heeler family and their friends as they play 10 games inspired by the show. Choose games featuring Bluey, Bingo, Dad, Mum, Muffin, Chloe and Honey by moving the slider to pick a character. Go into Dance Mode with Bluey, stop Rita from slipping on her beans with Bingo or find out what’s on Dad’s x-ray. Help Bluey tidy up and keep her promise to Mum, play a spy game with Chloe and Honey, and explore more. Games range from easy to trifficult. Press the Bluey button to hear her talk and say familiar phrases from the show. See ya! Intended for ages 3+ years. Requires 2 AA batteries. Batteries included for demo purposes only. New batteries recommended for regular use.
